title: Konjunktiv II — advanced usage and politeness
description: Learn about Konjunktiv II — advanced usage and politeness in German.
explanation: Konjunktiv II is used to express wishes, polite requests, and hypothetical situations (would, could, should).

examples.english: I would like to have a coffee.

examples.german: Wenn ich reich wäre, würde ich ein Haus kaufen.
examples.english: If I were rich, I would buy a house.

exercises.question: Ich ___ gern ein Glas Wasser.
exercises.explanation: Hätte is used for polite requests (would have).

exercises.question: Wenn ich Zeit ___, käme ich mit.
